name: tripo-3d
description: Generate and edit 3D models from text or images, including texturing, segmentation, rigging and animation, for games, apps and 3D printing with the Tripo API.
suggestedPrompts: Turn my reference image into a textured 3D model with PBR materials and export it as GLB.
Build a game-ready 3D character with PBR textures, rig it for animation, and export it as FBX.
Generate a custom 3D-printable figurine and export it as STL.
